title: Build and qualify whole-service optional Go gundeck

acceptance_criteria.description: Runnable whole-service gundeck preserves frozen public/internal APIs and Redis/Cassandra/brig/cannon/queue/native/SQS effects.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Early executable health/presence/storage slice compared with real Haskell, then full exact-source/binary original72 four-Go plus remaining Haskell peers and frozen38/13/40 records; serious inherited concerns documented, no original/default/oracle edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pinned Go module format/build/vet/race and security/dependency checks pass with concrete regressions.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual final pinned Go checks, strict typed input/generation/client isolation/TLS/SQS failure and native sharing/paging regressions; exact module pins and source/binary receipts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Optional packaging/default preservation and real cross-runtime storage/provider switchback are validated.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Nonroot image smoke, one-service Helm render/default/fail-closed proof, real persisted Redis/Cassandra/token/queue Haskell-to-Go and Go-to-Haskell switchback, bounded in-flight shutdown and operations smoke; no production or remote push.

handoff: Runnable Go health/presence/time plus real Cassandra notification retrieval implemented, including inline/reference payload validation, client filtering, last backward scan, per-page byte/count limits, legacy/v3 since-gap responses and brig activity RPC. Actual pinned Go race tests pass. Native/token/delivery/SQS/queue, original72/four-Go and remaining frozen comparisons, final quality/loaded shutdown, switchback and optional packaging still required. Not qualified or available.
